notes: The music video tab checks the clip it is given. A song from the catalogue carries a video id, and that clip used to play no matter what it was - a live take, a remix, or another song entirely - with NEXT hidden because there was only one candidate. A clip whose length is far from the song is now checked against a search by artist and title before it is trusted, and the results become the list NEXT walks.

A size that would not open may not have been the phone at all: a player row can hand over a URL with its own range on it, which is half a file and something an element cannot play. That parameter is removed before the picture and its own soundtrack see the URL, so a sharp size has a real chance here.
The size list now says which build it is, so a tab that behaves like an older one can be told apart from the page that shipped, and the footer says when the picture had to settle for a smaller size.
